verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau paanee niv chaladhaa neevaan chalaiaa|

en.bdb: As water flows downwards and takes with it whosoever meets it (and makes it also humble),

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabhanaa ra(n)gaa(n) no milai ral jai ralaiaa|

en.bdb: All the dyes mix up in water and it becomes one with every colour;
Erasing ego it does altruistic deeds;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠੁ ਨ ਡੋਬੈ ਪਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਹੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaaTh na ddobai paal kai sa(n)g loh taraiaa|

en.bdb: It does not sink the wood, it rather makes the iron swim with it;

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਹ ਸੁਕਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: vuThe meeh sukaal hoi ras kas upajaiaa|

en.bdb: It makes for prosperity when it rains in rainy season.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਇ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: jeevadhiaa mar saadh hoi safalio jag aaiaa ||20||

en.bdb: Likewise, the holy saints getting dead in life i.e. removing their ego, making their coming to the world fruitful.
